enchantments.tooltip: Intelligence +7: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +7 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Shatter +8: +8 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Sunder and Improved Sunder attempts.
Wizardry +145: +145 Enhancement bonus to spell points.
Exceptional Astute Skills Bonus: +7 Exceptional bonus to Disable Device, Repair and Search.
Trace of Madness: You can almost hear faint, panicked voices when this item is close to you. Perhaps the latent power of this item's hint of madness could be brought out by some catalyst.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
